~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ vss-a25-l25 building router vss ~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan {Vlan_ID_user}
  name {net_type_5_Vlan_name}
!
!
interface Port-channel{int_#}
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_user}
!
interface vlan{Vlan_ID_user}
  description {net_type_5_Vlan_name}
  ip address {User_Prefix_last_IP} {User_prefix_netmask}
  ip helper-address {IP_helper_address}
  no shutdown
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 

! ########### MULTICAST START ########### 
!
interface Vlan{Vlan_ID_user}
  ip pim sparse-mode
!
!copy running start
!
! ########### MULTICAST END #############
